name: Roan Detweiler-Bedell
tagline: CS student at UVM building interactive tools, hardware integrations, and games.

experience.description: Assembled, tested, and evaluated drone systems and payloads designed for wildfire mitigation. Coded circuit boards for quality testing using Arduino and C++.

Developed strong interpersonal skills serving customers. Led sporting events and private parties.
